classification: The proposed additive public facades/types plus a physical-running admission/replay stage require exact ADR0127 public-contract/phase approval. Draft is not approval-ready.

blocking_findings.finding: Existing FlowSuffixCheckpoint stores pages/runtime/locator/position-capture lengths and warning/error tails but explicitly excludes callback pass state. A new RefCell trace/request/consumption pass would not roll back automatically.
blocking_findings.required_design: Specify one private checkpoint token for all trace/request/event/page-assignment and consumed/unresolved state; restore on existing suffix rejection before region transition/replay. Add checkpoint owner and actual callsites to final manifest.

blocking_findings.finding: Subframes may be retained visual products, isolated measurements or deferred float/footnote bodies. A global event appended at dispatch cannot distinguish discarded work or certify final physical page, especially deferred FrameItems emitted without revisiting Content.
blocking_findings.required_design: Define scoped trace fragments or equivalent exact journal ownership, acceptance/rollback and final page association using existing sealed capture/store contracts. Do not label every subframe a no-op or infer page from current pages.len at first dispatch. Name precise consumers changed; no blanket extra-owner approval.

blocking_findings.finding: Strict ObservationEq/Relation are private to eval; current math/par_line request matchers use Func language equality and collapsed styles, not full new-request provenance. Native namespaces/Element/Plugin may remain Unproven.
blocking_findings.required_design: Name the exact private observation bridge/owner if reusing it, or explicit audited immutable capture capability. Never promote Unproven with Debug/hash/name/collapsed styles/coordinates. If an extra public field/type/signature is needed, include it in the final approved declaration.

blocking_findings.source: PageRunningRequest and proposed physical key; recipes.rs:553,602; context_occurrences.rs:38–80; context_stabilization.rs:916–1063,1158–1196
blocking_findings.finding: page+slot is a physical address, not retained producer identity. Same slot after override/reflow can carry different template/rules/style/file/source; existing producer protocol discards descendants on replacement. Public request fields do not yet define authoritative lineage or its replay validator.
blocking_findings.required_design: The reviewed revision now names a reached-SetPage ShowRecipe capture-only boundary. Complete its authoritative immutable lineage/matching and key-to-owner/frame lifecycle, including Bundle document ownership. Preserve every captured field and nearest Source; conserve deliberate Located aliases, instantiate raw repeats through retained slots, and never reuse a changed producer by physical key alone.

blocking_findings.finding: Fresh matrix proves static footer and five-layer causal records plus contextual positions; current proposal declares only Header/Footer slots and leaves canvas expansion undecided. Body Location page mismatch also exists in PageRun control.
blocking_findings.required_design: Resolve exact measured scope and each retained gap before approval. No all-layer claim from two slots, no passing-refusal claim from duplicate-label versus missing-label exits. Point2 source-derived per-store construction remains an independent blocking design requirement.

blocking_findings.finding: Current reservation traversals leave SetPage opaque; aliases/ContextIDs retained inside a selected template need explicit reserve-only correspondence before allocation, without dormant membership.
blocking_findings.required_design: Name the exact local reservation boundary and owner. Preserve existing shared arena and do not register/prepare dormant descendants.

blocking_findings.source: proposed PageRunningResolution.location; generic Located root identity protocol
blocking_findings.finding: Operational root identity must not be assigned to a Figure/Context semantic root or published as a query element.
blocking_findings.required_design: Specify separate root position registration or a proven already-prepared transport shape and fail-closed missing-frame behavior; children retain their own actual Locations.

nonblocking_good_boundaries: No fields changed on existing public Content/SetPageDelta/PageConfig/PagedDocument/Introspector/old outcome types in the draft.
No source reevaluation, renderer callbacks or global Frame/PDF introspection proposed.
Pending versus Complete remains closed; no incomplete document should escape.
Prepared aliases, captured fields, shared arena, retained sinks and five-attempt budget are explicitly retained.
limits: These are exact design obligations and source-backed refuters, not authorization to edit every named owner.
No complete algorithm is invented for unresolved per-store event construction or flow journaling. The final proposal must specify it before gate.
